subject: general
question: The term 'leg bye' is related to ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cricket**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Leg bye:-**

 
 
• **It is related to cricket.**
 
• It is a type of run scored by the batting team when the ball hits the batsman's body, instead of the bat, and then goes on to touch any part of the field, except the wicket-keeper's gloves. The batting team gets a run for this.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hockey:-**

 
 
• The game involves hitting a ball with a stick and scoring a goal by putting the ball into the opponent's net.
 
 
 
• **Badminton:-**
 
 
• It is a racket sport where players hit a shuttlecock back and forth over a net. 
 
 
 
• **Football:-**
 
 
• It is also known as soccer, is a sport where players use their feet to kick a ball into the opponent's goal.
